revenue_scope: Worldwide (US + Intl) 'OPSUMIT / OPSYNVI' line of J&J's Pulmonary Hypertension franchise: macitentan (Opsumit) plus the macitentan/tadalafil fixed-dose combination (Opsynvi).
why_separate: The gold series is OPSUMIT alone, last printed for 2024Q4. From 2025Q1 J&J prints one line that also holds OPSYNVI, a formulation of macitentan combined with tadalafil, and restates FY2024 from 2,184 to 2,225.
notes: Span 2025Q1-2026Q2, each quarter read from its own schedule as current. The 2025Q1 supplemental table restates 2024 to 524, 548, 583, 570 (full year 2,225) against the OPSUMIT-only 2024 rows of the gold series (Q2 544, Q3 571, Q4 545; full year 2,184), so the combination added 4, 12 and 25 in 2024Q2-Q4 (2024Q1 524 is the same as the OPSUMIT-only first quarter, 1,068 six months less 544). Annual check: the 2025Q4 schedule's twelve-month figure 2,325 equals 522+582+578+643. The product is the same macitentan line under a new label with a formulation added, so the relation is renamed_line.
search_log: Reused the J&J investor-site quarterly schedule PDFs 2014Q3-2026Q2 already downloaded for the sibling J&J manifests (48 files; 2023Q2 downloaded again from its sibling-manifest URL) and extracted every page with pdfplumber into text; searched all 49 documents case-insensitively for the product names (counts reported per product below).
